The Top 20 Largest Property Management Companies 2025

Below is a list of the top 20 largest residential property management companies in the US. The figures are self-reported. Only 3rd party doors are counted. Data as of April 2025. Note this list covers SFR + small multifamily only (properties under 100 doors).
